name: 14303 · Niagara Falls, NY
findings: ZIP 14303 (Niagara Falls) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14303 (Niagara Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14303 (Niagara Falls) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
